en: Black-and-white panoramic view over a densely built town with many low houses and a few larger buildings on gently rolling hills. A mostly dry riverbed or stream curves through the left foreground with trees along its banks. The town extends into the distance. Along the lower edge of the image there is printed text in Greek and French, and a web address watermark appears in the bottom right.
